docusign.name: DocuSign Integration by LC Bridge
docusign.requirements: GoHighLevel account and an existing DocuSign account; configured template mappings and enabled workflows
docusign.description: Connect DocuSign agreements to GoHighLevel contact data, configured follow-up workflows, and completed-answer sync. Built for GoHighLevel (GHL), also known as HighLevel.
docusign.trial: 14-day free trial; no card to start; DocuSign subscription billed separately

community-agents.name: Community Agents by LC Bridge
community-agents.requirements: Marketplace installation in the owning GoHighLevel sub-account, a member-facing community portal, and a dedicated member login for each AI identity
community-agents.description: AI replies for GoHighLevel community teams using supplied knowledge, private previews, and member assessments supported by source conversations. Built for GoHighLevel (GHL), also known as HighLevel.
community-agents.usageMetering: 4 times provider cost; included allowance used first, overage billed through GoHighLevel wallet

google-sheets.name: Google Sheets integration for GoHighLevel by LC Bridge
google-sheets.marketplaceName: Google Sheets integration by LC Bridge
google-sheets.description: Bring GoHighLevel data into Google Sheets, explore 25 report templates, and review spreadsheet edits before updating matching contacts and opportunities.
google-sheets.requirements: An authorized GoHighLevel account, a Google account with access to the chosen spreadsheet, and appropriate record permissions. Production access is offered through early access.

pricing.unit: Successfully transferred primary record per execution
countingRules: Each execution counts its successfully transferred primary records. Transferring the same record in another execution adds usage again.
Retries of the same delivery operation must not create duplicate charges.
Supporting lookups and embedded invoice or order line items are bundled with their primary records.
Refreshing a report from already delivered worksheet data is not another provider record transfer. A source refresh that transfers records adds usage.
Applicable account markup and tax can change the final charge.
High-volume teams can discuss a custom subscription with more predictable costs.
pricing.billingStatus: The website explains planned rates and estimates; it does not activate billing.

capabilityEvidence.outgoingUpdates: Reviewed updates to eligible fields on matching Contacts and Opportunities; no automatic outgoing writes.
capabilityEvidence.importMode: Manual or scheduled imports; production source acceptance varies by object.
capabilityEvidence.excluded: Workflow run reporting is unavailable. No claim of universal object writeback, email body availability, unlimited scale, or measured production performance.
capabilityEvidence.sampleData: Invented relational records, frozen to October 2026. Public previews never connect a live account.
capabilityEvidence.whiteLabel: Brand-neutral inside the app: no agency, LC Bridge or HighLevel branding. The CRM is called "CRM", record buttons say "Open in CRM", and HighLevel is never named in the app, its statuses or its errors. Confirmed by Karthik Anand on 2026-10-25.
capabilityEvidence.integrations: Facebook Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, CallRail, Stripe and QuickBooks, joined to contacts by recorded IDs; all six included in early access. Confirmed by Karthik Anand on 2026-10-25.
